merged.rule: kit/07-QUALITY-BAR.md: a set over critics.maxFilesPerMessage is split across two fresh critics with the same rubric and their answers are merged; the merged score is the lower of the two, the issues are both lists in order

issues.where: crops 1-4 and 2, the curved hypocotyl from the hook down to the soil (same in set-C-08.png)
issues.what: the stem skin is a single smooth, even waxy surface with a perfectly clean green-to-red gradient; no fine cell texture, no colour mottling, no thickness change and no light passing through the thin hook against the sun, so it reads as a plastic tube even with the rim hairs
issues.fix: add fine longitudinal cell texture and slight colour irregularity, add subsurface translucency so the backlit hook glows warmer and lighter than the shaded side, and vary the diameter slightly along its length

issues.where: crops 1, 3 and 4, the seed coat on the bud (same in set-C-05.png)
issues.what: the dark and light stripes are evenly spaced and of even width like a printed texture, and the coat's outline is knife-sharp and cleaner than the stem beside it; the opening shows a flat, even yellow-green strip with no depth
issues.fix: break up the stripe widths and edges, add a little dry, flaky roughness and frayed edges where the coat splits, and give the cotyledon inside the split some shading and depth

issues.where: crops 1-4, the dark soil specks on the stem (same in set-C-08.png)
issues.what: the specks stuck to the stem are all about the same size and roundness and sit on the surface like dots pasted onto it, with no contact shadow
issues.fix: vary their size and shape, add a few tiny grains, and give each one a small contact shadow on the stem

issues.where: crops 1-5, the soil clods in the focus zone (same in set-C-05.png and set-C-08.png)
issues.what: the clods have cool blue-grey glittery highlights and faceted edges, so they read more like gravel or coal than damp, crumbly earth
issues.fix: warm and soften the specular highlights, add a few fine crumbs and organic fibres, and round off some of the facets

issues.where: crop 5, where the stem enters the soil (same in set-C-05.png)
issues.what: the stem goes cleanly into the mound with no lifted or cracked soil ring and only a faint contact darkening, so the emergence looks placed rather than pushed up
issues.fix: add a small crack or lifted crumbs round the base and a deeper occlusion shadow where the stem meets the soil

issues.where: crop 4, dew on the plant (same in set-C-05.png)
issues.what: the dew is only a few tiny pale specks on the top of the hook, too sparse to read as dew at delivery size
issues.fix: add a few small beads that refract the sky and catch the sun along the hook and upper stem, or drop dew from the brief

issues.where: both cotyledon leaves and the stem, crops 1, 3 and 4
issues.what: the dew is tiny flat white specks, all about the same size and evenly scattered. They don't refract, don't bulge, have no dark rim and catch no colour from behind, so they look painted on rather than sitting on the surface as drops
issues.fix: make the drops refractive spheres in a mix of sizes (a few larger beads near the edges, some merged), each with an inverted refraction, a dark edge and one specular highlight, and cluster them naturally instead of spreading them evenly

issues.where: face of the left cotyledon, crops 1 and 3
issues.what: faint, evenly spaced parallel lines run across the leaf like a tiled texture or mesh grid, not organic venation. The vein pattern reads as painted on, with no relief
issues.fix: replace it with a non-repeating texture that has a midrib and branching veins, and add slight bump or normal relief so the veins catch the light

issues.what: the leaf is one smooth, saturated green with a waxy, plastic sheen. It has no mottling and no thickness variation, and the backlight passing through the leaf shows no vein structure, so it looks like a uniform card
issues.fix: vary the colour and roughness across the leaf, and add subsurface scattering in which the veins show darker against the backlit tissue. Give the edge some thickness and slight irregularity

issues.what: the stem is an almost perfectly uniform cylinder with little taper and no colour change toward the base (no reddish or pale hypocotyl). The dew dots on it repeat the same size
issues.fix: add a slight taper, a subtle colour gradient toward the soil and a little surface irregularity

issues.where: leaf margins against the bright background, crop 1
issues.what: the outlines are very clean and sharp, close to a knife edge, with a thin even yellow rim line all the way round
issues.fix: vary the rim light's width and add tiny irregularities and hairs along the margin
